data.description: A howler's constant howling is a grating, exhausting baying that can drive listeners insane.  All beings other than outsiders within 120 feet of a howling howler must succeed on a DC %1 Will save or become cursed by the creature's howl.  Once a creature becomes cursed in this way, she takes no additional penalty for being exposed to additional howlers' howls until the current howler curse is lifted.  This is a sonic mind-affecting effect.  Howler Howl: Curse - howl; save Fort DC %1 negates; frequency 1/hour; effect 1 Wis damage; cure 1 save.
data.name: Howl
